is_on only matches state_status exactly against StateStatus.supercooling or superfreezing, so it stays off when the device reports another status (e.g. 146 supercooling_superfreezing) or the status is not coerced to the enum. It also never writes state after the action.

The status values the switch compares against (superfreezing=13, supercooling=14, supercooling_superfreezing=146) may not cover what the API now reports, so the enum may need adjusting alongside the switch.
